stem: A class has 40 students. 15 of them are boys. What fraction of the class are boys?
hints: A fraction of a group is the part over the whole.
The part is the 15 boys. The whole is all 40 students. Write 15/40.
Simplify 15/40 by dividing the top and the bottom by 5.

solution.methodName: Fraction of a whole: part over whole, then simplify

steps.action: The whole is the whole class: 40. So the fraction is 15/40.
steps.why: The bottom of the fraction is always the whole group, not the other part.

steps.action: So 3/8 of the class are boys.

trapNotes.5/8: This is the fraction of girls: 40 − 15 = 25 girls, and 25/40 = 5/8. The question asks about boys.
trapNotes.8/3: This is upside down. The part (15) goes on top and the whole (40) goes on the bottom.
trapNotes.3/5: This is boys over girls, 15/25. The bottom must be the whole class, 40.
